summary: Completed comprehensive testing of TaskFlow To-Do application. Backend API shows 85% success rate with minor issues. Frontend UI working excellently with login, dashboard, tasks page, and profile functionality all operational.

minor_bugs.issue: API root endpoint returns 404 instead of expected 200
DELETE task returns 204 instead of expected 200
Returns 422 validation error - requires request body

ui_bugs.issue: Filter dropdown options (PENDING, URGENT) not easily accessible

design_issues.issue: Logout functionality not easily accessible through UI

passed_tests: Dashboard page loads with stats (10 total, 3 completed, 30% rate)
Tasks page shows all 10 sample tasks correctly
Profile page loads with user info and forms
Backend API authentication and token management
Task filtering by status, priority, category, due date
Notifications system (5 notifications with proper status)
action_item_for_main_agent: Minor fixes needed: 1) Fix logout API validation error, 2) Improve filter dropdown accessibility, 3) Add clear user menu for logout. All core functionality working excellently.
